conditions.requires: Both spawn and sereneseasons loaded; exact supported Spawn 4.0.7 SunflowerBlock rotation/bonemeal contracts and native Serene Seasons public growth callback.

conditions.delivery: Integration in the full local pack is tracked in Mods/JEMCompat/seasons-delivery.json; native runtime and player acceptance remain separate.

change.summary: Close the mature Spawn sunflower scheduled seed-growth bypass while preserving native sun tracking and using Serene Seasons as the single fertility owner.

modifiers.before: Mature SunflowerBlock.tryAdvanceRotation is reached by random and scheduled ticks; dawn seed refill and performBonemeal have no native Serene Seasons block-tag gate. Tagging the mature block would still miss scheduled refill while suppressing sun tracking.
modifiers.after: Intercept only a false-to-true SEEDS transition and mature unseeded performBonemeal. Invoke native SeasonalCropGrowthHandler.onCropGrowth once using the tagged juvenile SUNFLOWER_PLANT state at the actual mature position. Apply the native admission result without duplicating calendar, fertility chance or greenhouse rules.
modifiers.notes: The mature block stays outside seasonal block tags; its real block item and sunflower_seeds tooltip use summer/autumn. Denied natural refill still advances rotation. Existing ripe seeds remain harvestable. A native removal or replacement during policy evaluation is never overwritten.

modifiers.before: No specific cross-mod adapter or compile-only native contracts.
modifiers.after: Separate required mixin config, guarded by both mod IDs before target resolution; exact required/allowed injection counts. Missing installed Spawn target class fails visibly. Compile-only existing Spawn/Serene Seasons pack JARs, with no new bundled runtime library.
modifiers.notes: Absent optional mods skip the adapter; an installed incompatible target is not silently treated as absent. No global modification of other optional mixin failure policy.

rationale.purpose: Make mature sunflower seed production obey the same native seasonal owner without canceling visual rotation or leaving the scheduled route open.
rationale.decision_source: User requested implementation of the supplied crop-compatibility patch on 2026-10-23; seasonal windows and adapter mechanics follow that supplied technical direction.
rationale.user_requested: Implement all supplied Serene Seasons crop compatibility and coordinate with the parallel handbook/Hint/Jade chat.
rationale.implementation_choices: Reuse the native public growth callback with the juvenile crop metadata; add only a seed-transition redirect and bonemeal injection, with narrow optional class detection.

introduced.summary: Delegate only mature sunflower seed-refill attempts to native Serene Seasons policy from both rotation and bonemeal routes, retaining rotation/harvest and optional dependency boundaries.

history.summary: Delegate only mature sunflower seed-refill attempts to native Serene Seasons policy from both rotation and bonemeal routes, retaining rotation/harvest and optional dependency boundaries.

Merge supplied policy with current source and parallel handbook build dependencies; inspect exact installed Spawn and Serene Seasons bytecode and retain native fertility authority. Delivery receipt records production and installation evidence.

relations: Spawn native seed attempt -> JEMCompat adapter -> Serene Seasons native fertility
juvenile seasonal tag policy -> mature seed refill
sunflower seeds -> native harvest and downstream uses
notes: No additional state, saved data, tick scheduler, crop registry or client authority. Native scheduled/random calls converge on one narrow seed transition.
The juvenile perennial protection tag prevents destructive-mode removal for this metadata; the adapter additionally preserves any actual native position mutation.

Bonemeal uses the native fertility/probability gate but retains caller-owned consumption and feedback. A valid ordinary use consumes one bonemeal even on denial; success particles/result can remain because only performBonemeal is cancelled, unlike the native Serene Seasons player-event wrapper. Dispenser/direct callers retain their own item handling.

Exact installed Spawn 4.0.7 and Serene Seasons 9.1.0.3 SHA256 match the referenced Atlas artifacts; javap confirms tryAdvanceRotation/setBlock and performBonemeal descriptors and the public native fertility callback. Local fertility config remains enabled with behavior 0 and underground level 48.
unresolved: Gameplay acceptance, greenhouse/biome conditions, dispenser/direct bonemeal and absent-mod JVM loading remain unexercised; no tests or client gameplay launches are authorized.
Other mod fertilizers, queued callbacks and direct automation are not universally intercepted; documented native exceptions remain deliberate.
